function.name: add_item
function.description: Add a new item to the inventory.

item_name.description: Specify the name of the item. Must be a non-empty string.

category.description: Specify the category of the item. Must be a non-empty string.

quantity.description: Specify the quantity of the item. Must be a positive integer.

supplier.description: Specify the supplier of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

description.description: Provide a description of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

function.name: update_item
function.description: Update an existing item in the inventory.

item_id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the item. Must be a non-empty string.

item_name.description: Specify the new name of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

category.description: Specify the new category of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

quantity.description: Specify the new quantity of the item. Must be a positive integer if provided.

supplier.description: Specify the new supplier of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

description.description: Provide the new description of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

function.name: delete_item
function.description: Delete an item from the inventory.

item_id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the item. Must be a non-empty string.

function.name: search_items
function.description: Search for items in the inventory by keyword or category.

keyword.description: Specify the keyword to search for in the item name. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

category.description: Specify the category to search for. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve. Must be a positive integer if provided.

results_per_page.description: Specify the maximum number of results per page. Must be a positive integer if provided.

function.name: get_item_details
function.description: Get detailed information about an item in the inventory.

item_id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the item. Must be a non-empty string.

function.name: track_inventory
function.description: Track inventory levels and receive notifications when stock levels are low.

threshold.description: Specify the stock level threshold. Must be a positive integer.

function.name: setup_alert
function.description: Set up an alert for a specific item or category when the stock reaches a certain threshold.

alert_id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the alert. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

item_id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

category.description: Specify the category of the item. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

threshold.description: Specify the stock level threshold. Must be a positive integer.

operation.description: Specify the operation to perform on the alert.

keyword.description: Specify the keyword to search for in the supplier name. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve. Must be a positive integer if provided.

results_per_page.description: Specify the maximum number of results per page. Must be a positive integer if provided.

function.name: list_categories
function.description: List available categories in the inventory.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve. Must be a positive integer if provided.

results_per_page.description: Specify the maximum number of results per page. Must be a positive integer if provided.

function.name: update_inventory_cost
function.description: Update the cost of the specified drug in the inventory.

drug_name.description: Specify the name of the drug to update.

new_cost.description: Specify the new unit cost of the drug.
